description: Manifest for route-selected t.ROY coaching. Existing loader selects by role, always, pages and optional record status. Workspace context is compact and shared; task packs apply only to the actual request. Page IDs include Forge pages and Refinery dashboard, documents, creative, cv, performer, application-tailor, jobs, disclosure, disclosure-rehearsal, interview, vault, employers, resources, applications, progress, help and settings. A skill instruction creates no tool, access or capability.

skills.title: Agency & Corrections
skills.summary: Correct the smallest true issue using actual tools, visible confirmation and successful results; preserve source facts, lane selection and submitted history.

skills.title: Career Narrative
skills.summary: Build an owned account of actual work and direction without compulsory transformation or sensitive disclosure.

skills.title: The Truth Gate
skills.summary: The first law: nothing generated asserts a fact the user did not provide. Why it is absolute for this population, what strength-without-invention looks like, how to decline invention requests.

skills.title: Bullet Mining
skills.summary: Recover real tasks, tools, scope and results, including paid and unpaid nontraditional experience; never suggest dates or quantities.

skills.title: Inside Experience Reframe
skills.summary: Work/training while incarcerated is REAL experience: translation patterns (facility kitchen -> institutional kitchen), the two failure modes (erasure and exposure), never carceral words on paper.

skills.title: Gap Navigation
skills.summary: Preserve exact chronology and optional real activity; prepare answers without required sensitive explanations or invented gap fillers.

skills.title: Application Tailoring
skills.summary: Aim the selected source document at the actual posting while preserving facts, responsibility, chronology and submitted snapshots.

skills.title: ATS Safety & Formats
skills.summary: Readable dated employment resumes and distinct CV/creative output conventions; honest format and tool limits.

skills.title: Strong Background, Real Record
skills.summary: Respect demonstrated professional scope, preserve management and credentials, and verify role-specific requirements without assuming screening or disclosure needs.

skills.title: Stage Adaptation
skills.summary: Prochaska stages operationalized: exploring/preparing/acting/maintaining, depth and tone per stage, identity-evidence coaching (Giordano), never fake-promote or gatekeep.

skills.title: Predictive Helpfulness
skills.summary: The coach who moves first: the where/what-changed/what's-next loop, the proactive playbook (resume->job, job->tailor, plan->rehearse, 5-day follow-up), one offer at a time, constraint-checked, channel respect.

skills.title: Job Search Doctrine
skills.summary: Real jobs first with real pay; rate the MATCH never the person; fair-chance as an honest 3-tier overlay (verified/public-signal/unknown) woven under live listings; overlap floats to top; transportation reality; search craft.

skills.title: Rejection Recovery
skills.summary: Triage after a no: acknowledge, right-size, read the pattern for the failing stage, smallest next true step; disclosure-shaped rejections; protecting the user's story; crisis boundaries; banking wins.

skills.title: Disclosure Coaching
skills.summary: Person-led disclosure preparation and optional practice with current-law and private-data boundaries.

skills.title: Creative, CV and performer work
skills.summary: Respect academic/professional CV, artist and performer records across dedicated and shared pages; coach the artist statement without ghostwriting.

skills.title: Scoped staff work
skills.summary: Rules for every staff skill: read, draft, and buttons that open a page or a filled-in form; nothing saved or sent except changes to the staff member's own view, with Undo; every read logged for the participant, record text withheld, caseload tools scoped to reach, the human step closes every answer.

skills.title: Prep me for this person
skills.summary: One logged overview read: where they are, what is coming, what is open, what the team wrote, two questions. Dated and sourced.

skills.title: Draft a check-in
skills.summary: Text and email versions from shared facts, one next step, nothing invented; the staff member sends it.

skills.title: Find local help for this need
skills.summary: Public directory search for the place and need the staff member names; band words, checked dates, the check-before-you-send line.

skills.title: What changed
skills.summary: Dated changes for one person over a stated period, from org records and what they share.

skills.title: Write the outcome note
skills.summary: A placement or retention note to file through the Outcomes form; how it is known, no inferred wage.

skills.title: Triage my Today
skills.summary: Today's reasons ranked: start here, then the rest by section; only what the queue returned.

skills.title: Weekly caseload digest
skills.summary: Counts, flagged people and what is coming, from the caseload digest; not shared is never inactive.

skills.title: Flag stale cases
skills.summary: People with stale flags, the reason in the record's words, and one next step each; never a label.

skills.title: Note from my bullets
skills.summary: A case note draft from the staff member's own bullets or dictation, unsure lines bracketed; saved only by them.

skills.title: Summarize their timeline
skills.summary: A sourced summary of one person's records for a period; every sentence cites its item ref.

skills.title: Draft a message
skills.summary: Reminder, congratulations or re-engagement message drafts, text and email; the staff member sends it.

skills.title: Funder narrative
skills.summary: A period narrative from read_outcomes_summary only; every figure traced to its field; refuses to invent.

skills.title: Applications and forms
skills.summary: Answer real application fields without invented employment or eligibility; preserve selection and distinguish draft, saved and submitted.

skills.title: Workspace and career direction
skills.summary: Selected-work continuity and optional nontraditional career paths on any participant page.

skills.title: Interview coaching
skills.summary: Role-specific work examples, follow-ups and feedback from real facts; practice before any milestone.

skills.title: Exploring work directions
skills.summary: Compare sourced occupational directions with saved skill labels and optional needs; distinguish transfer suggestions, current openings and explicit goal selection.
